architecture_changes: fine-tuned on real human-written simplification pairs from the ASSET corpus (facebook/asset on HF Hub, 880 train / 120 val examples sampled from its validation+test splits, 12 epochs, AdamW lr=3e-4, best-val-loss checkpoint kept); supersedes an earlier version fine-tuned on only 15 synthetic examples for 60 epochs, which badly overfit and regurgitated memorized training topics on novel input
